composition_label: Journey recommendations -> Deep research -> Ticket triage & routing

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory; no source files or other builds consulted.

input.synthetic: Must be true; the example and tests use explicitly synthetic data
input.user: id, ordered goals, completed_actions referencing the action catalog
input.actions: Unique id, title, goals, prerequisite action IDs, research_topics
input.documents: Unique id, title, structured claims: topic, stance, text. One claim per topic per document.
input.routing: Ordered categories with id, exact topics, owner and queue; fallback_category; reason-to-priority mapping

output.envelope: schema_version, synthetic, request_id, status=ok, journey, research, triage
output.journey: user_id, eligible next_actions, exactly two ordered steps, deduplicated research_topics
output.research: journey_action_ids, cited document_ids, topic reports with evidence, source_count, synthesis, disagreement, reason_codes, unresolved_questions
output.triage: One ticket per selected research topic: stable id, topic, action_ids, document_ids, category, priority, owner, queue, reason_codes, questions, summary

shared_schema.validation: One shared validate() layer checks strict input keys, types, unique identities, references and acyclic prerequisites. Each downstream consumer validates its upstream record before use. Canonical deterministic output contracts are checked recursively, including exact quotations, order, source counts, routing, and bool/int distinctions.
shared_schema.bounds: Strings have 1..2000 characters and no surrounding whitespace. Lists have at most 100 entries. At least two catalog actions and one user goal are required. Completed actions must include their prerequisites. Unknown fields are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated selected action IDs and their research topics define the entire research scope. Irrelevant document claims are excluded.
Validated topic reports propagate exact action/source identities, synthesis, disagreement and missing/uncertain evidence questions into categorized, prioritized, accountable tickets.

behavior.journey: Enumerates feasible ordered two-step plans without repeating completed actions. Maximizes weighted overlap with ordered user goals, then first-step relevance, then lexical action IDs. Prerequisites may be goal-unrelated when they unlock the relevant second step. A goal-irrelevant or impossible plan is an error.
behavior.research: Deterministically groups structured claims by selected topic across documents. Each topic denotes one shared proposition. Supports and opposes constitute disagreement. Missing evidence, uncertain stances and single-document evidence create explicit unresolved questions. Counts never assert factual truth or source independence.
behavior.routing: The first category whose exact topic matches wins; otherwise an explicitly owned fallback category is used. Highest configured severity across reason codes wins using low < normal < high < urgent. Reason codes are disagreement, missing_evidence, uncertain, limited_sources, resolved. Resolved means no issue detected in supplied stances, not externally verified truth.
behavior.determinism: No clock, randomness, provider, network or mutable global state. Catalog and document input ordering do not change output; configured category order intentionally does.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout. Successful runs exit 0. Invalid JSON, duplicate object keys, non-finite numbers, invalid schema, decoding errors and file errors return status=error and exit 2.

included: Prerequisite-aware personalized next actions and an exactly two-step journey
Multi-document structured evidence synthesis with traceable quotations
Disagreement, uncertain evidence, evidence gaps and corroboration questions
Configurable categorization, priority and accountable owner/queue routing
Shared boundary validation and end-to-end provenance
Synthetic fixtures, CLI contract tests, tampered and stale handoff tests
excluded: Live research, providers, web retrieval and external source verification
LLM or injected callable; the implementation is fully deterministic
Natural-language claim extraction, semantic topic matching and adjudication of factual truth
Real customer data, production support integrations and actual ticket submission
Persistence, authentication, asynchronous work and enterprise operational infrastructure
scope.ancillary_prompt_log: docs\My_prompt.txt records the supplied prompts under the mandatory session logging policy; it is not a runtime deliverable.
